<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a strong M+1 peak (~13 % of the base) indicating many carbons, and a very prominent M+2 peak (~33 % of the base) matching the natural abundance of chlorine’s 37Cl isotope—we can definitively identify carbon and chlorine in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
